query:
Hack together a quick prototype in scraper.py that parses this literal HTML and prints the title plus all h1 and h2 text: Example

Hello

News

. Use only the Python standard library and run it once.
expected_behavior: Selects builder — making something real from scratch, fast

Does not load workflow techniques whose complexity, parallelism, or Git preconditions are absent
Does not start polishing or refactoring code that does not exist yet
